patch_description: This candidate replaces the sparse shared-RZ/CZ seed with a symmetric, parameter-tied brickwork block. It keeps the same fixed training loop and measurements, but uses a more expressive and better-conditioned ansatz per upload: independent entry RY rotations, local CZ entangling, shared cross-half RZ layers, cross-half CRY couplings, shifted CZ entangling, and a mirrored exit RY layer that reuses the entry parameters. This structure preserves parameter efficiency while increasing mixing across the 8 qubits, which should help reduce validation/test loss and accelerate convergence without changing the program’s inputs or outputs.
